title: Reverse Story · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Reverse Story · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on a simple fictional event with a beginning, middle and end. The lead tells the three parts starting with the ending and finishing with the beginning. The group can identify all three parts in reverse order. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Reverse Story, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group can identify all three parts in reverse order.
recall.why: The group can identify all three parts in reverse order.
